title: Small Business Finance Corporation Amendment Ordinance 1979

sections.shortTitle: Small Business Finance Corporation Amendment Ordinance 1979
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE LV OF 1979
ORDINANCE LV OF 1979
SMALL BUSINESS FINANCE CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to amend the Small Business Finance Corporation
Act, 1972
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th October, 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :‑
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance
may be called the Small Business Finance Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance,
1979.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 2, Act XXIX of 1972

ORDINANCE LV OF 1979
ORDINANCE LV OF 1979
SMALL BUSINESS FINANCE CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to amend the Small Business Finance Corporation
Act, 1972
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th October, 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :‑
2. Amendment of section 2, Act XXIX of 1972: In the Small Business
Finance Corporation Act, 1972 (XXIX of 1972), hereinafter referred to as the
said Act, in section 2, after clause (c), the following new clause shall be
inserted, namely :‑
(cc) "cottage industry"
means an industrial undertaking the value of the fixed assets of which,
excluding the cost of land but including the amount of any loan advanced by the
Corporation, does not exceed three hundred ' thousand rupees.".

3. Amendment of section 17, Act XXIX of 1972.‑In the said
Act, in section 17, after the word "companies" at the end, the words
"other than companies to which a loan has been advanced by the
Corporation" shall be inserted.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 18, Act XXIX of 1972

ORDINANCE LV OF 1979
ORDINANCE LV OF 1979
SMALL BUSINESS FINANCE CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to amend the Small Business Finance Corporation
Act, 1972
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th October, 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :‑
4. Amendment of section 18, Act XXIX of 1972. ‑In the said
Act, in section 18,‑
(a) for subsection (1) the
following shall be substituted, namely :‑
"(1) The following shall be
eligible for loans from the Corporation for such purposes, to such extent and
subject to such conditions as may be prescribed, namely‑
(a) individuals and firms having
net assets not exceeding fifty thousand rupees in value ;
(b) all classes of small business
owned or sponsored by any such individual or firm ; and
(c) a cottage industry owned or
sponsored by any individual, firm or company." ; and
(b) in subsection (2).
(i) for, the comma and words
", profession or industry" the words "or profession shall be
substituted ; and
(ii) for the full‑stop at
the end a colon shall be substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall
be added, namely :‑
"Provided that, in the case
of a cottage industry, this subsection shall have effect as if for the words
"fifty thousand rupees" the words "one hundred and fifty
thousand rupees" were substituted.".
